notes: Unit 3 is finished. static, scope and the this keyword complete Class Creation at nine topics out of nine, which is the whole of free response question 2. Nine concepts, thirty exercises, and every worked example animates.

The line that every constructor needs is taught as the point of the topic. A parameter named after the field it sets hides that field, so the obvious line assigns the parameter to itself, achieves nothing, and leaves the field at null. It compiles. Nothing warns you. this.name = name is the fix, and the lesson also shows the version written backwards, which compiles just as happily and throws the argument away instead.

static is taught by the question that decides it: could two objects sensibly disagree about this. A balance yes, an owner yes, how many accounts exist no, because that is not a fact about an account at all.
Coverage is 45 of the College Board's 57 topics. Units 1 and 3 are complete, Unit 2 is at nine of twelve, and what remains is mostly array traversals, searching, sorting and recursion.
